channel.title: Field Notes | Chris Garin
channel.description: Brand histories and field notes from Chris Garin.

item.title: Heatseeker: the tool I built to never face a blank page again | Chris Garin
item.description: For years my ideas died in my notes because I could not build them. So I learned to build. Heatseeker is what came out of it.

item.title: How a Realtor's Postcards Beat His Email Funnel | Chris Garin
item.description: Two realtors, opposite playbooks, same result. The thing that actually works is paying attention to one person at a time.

item.title: I Wasn't Lazy. I Was Scared. | Chris Garin
item.description: I procrastinated for a year before making content again. I thought I was lazy. It was fear wearing a better outfit.

item.title: Pax Silica Explained: What It Is and Why China Is Mad
item.description: What the US-led Pax Silica coalition and the proposed New Clark City hub actually mean for the Philippines, explained simply.

item.title: IMAX in the Philippines: History, Screens, and Locations
item.description: Everything about IMAX in the Philippines: how it arrived in 2006, who owns and runs it, whether it is real IMAX or LieMAX, and where to watch it.

item.title: TCL History: Who Owns It and Is It a Good TV Brand?
item.description: The full story of TCL: what the letters mean, who owns it, whether it is any good, and how it became the number one TV brand in the Philippines.

item.title: Ayala History: From the 1834 Roxas Founding to Ayala Land
item.description: How Ayala went from an 1834 distillery founded by the Roxas family to Ayala Land and the Philippines oldest conglomerate, and who runs it now.

item.title: SkyFlakes History: Who Owns It and Is It Really Filipino?
item.description: The full story of SkyFlakes crackers: the M.Y. San origin, who owns it today, why it is a Filipino icon, and even how many holes each cracker has.

item.title: Who Owns Chooks-to-Go? The Owner and Full History
item.description: Who owns Chooks-to-Go, the company behind it, its tagline, and how the roast chicken brand grew across the Philippines. The complete backstory.

item.title: Who Owns Puregold? The Lucio and Susan Co Story
item.description: Who owns Puregold: the Lucio and Susan Co story, how they founded it, their S&R connection, and how it became a Philippine retail giant.

item.title: GCash History: When It Launched and Who Created It
item.description: GCash history in full: when it launched, who created it, its link to Globe, and how it became the Philippines biggest e-wallet.
